title: Peradeniya InnovateX
description: A hybrid hackathon centered on agri-tech and rural innovation, reflecting Peradeniya's engineering and agriculture research strengths. Regional teams could join a satellite site in Kandy while judging happened centrally.
location: Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya + Kandy satellite site
whoCanParticipate: Open to undergraduates from any faculty, not just engineering - agri-tech teams especially encouraged.
